name: Monossoi Shigarayakisky
original_name: モノッソイ・シガラヤキスキー
source: Russian shop keeper. Has very unique items for cheap prices can't find anywhere else. Is rumor that the items are stolen. Friendly towards everyone but will occasional rip off his customers without them knowing.
